meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会打开浏览器访问网页,读取页面内容,执行点击、填表、截图、提取数据,也能保存登录状态、等待页面加载。
howto.when: 当任务需要查询资料、填写网页表单、和网页应用交互等任何能用浏览器完成的事情时,即使你没直接说,它也可能主动调用。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,把表单填了再提交
say.note: 会用快照找表单元素并填写提交。

say.text: 截取这个页面的全屏截图
say.note: 执行截图命令保存图片。

say.text: 把页面上的商品链接和标题都抓下来
say.note: 读取元素文本和链接属性来提取。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can launch a browser to open URLs, read page content, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, save/load login state, and wait for page conditions.
howto.when_en: Whenever a browser would be helpful for the task, such as researching, filling forms, interacting with web apps, taking screenshots, or extracting data — even if the user does not explicitly ask.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com, fill the form, and submit it.
say_en.note: Uses snapshot to locate fields and submit.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot of this page.
Extract all product links and titles from this page.
